fit_quality.note: AC intentionally loose — archetype identity lives largely in the AC/HP trade.

chassis._comment: Baseline expected values for a Balanced creature at a given CR. Computed in JS, never by the LLM. CR below 1: use anchor table, not formulas.

observed_spread._comment: Lint bounds. Generated blocks outside archetype-adjusted versions of these ranges get rejected or corrected.

structural_tiers._comment: How many mechanical slots a block gets. Empirical breakpoints from SRD 5.2.1: multiattack goes 0% (CR 0) -> ~40% (CR 1-2) -> ~80-90% (CR 3-5) -> 100% (CR 6+); legendary actions appear ~CR 10, dominant CR 13+, universal CR 21+.

archetypes._comment: Multipliers apply to chassis values, then round. required_slots are structural obligations the generator must fill; the LLM chooses/writes flavor for them, never the numbers.

required_slots: reaction (tier 3+): protect ally or punish movement
movement trick: bonus-action Disengage, flyby, spider climb, or burrow
skirmisher.speed_note: speed_mod added 2026-08-05 (owner: "I picked a skirmisher though? is that not coming through?"): skirmisher carried hp_mult 0.95 and NOTHING else — baseline with a rounding error — so even a correct kit never said skirmisher in the stat line. Speed is the role's actual identity and no archetype touched it.

required_slots: high-damage melee or close-range attack routine
an all-in trait that buys offense with its own safety (advantage on its attacks while attacks against it have advantage, extra damage when it presses recklessly, or a similar bargain)
forbidden: defensive traits that reduce or mitigate incoming damage

required_slots: save-based action imposing a condition (2024 capitalized condition names)
buff, heal, or enable action targeting allies
support.solo_warning: flag in UI: supports underperform their CR when encountered alone

required_slots: swarm trait (occupy other creatures' space, no Tiny-space penalty)
condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned
half-damage attack mode at or below half HP
swarm.hp_mult_note: measured 2026-08-04: 7/7 printed swarms run 0.79-1.12x band HP (median 0.80) — the B/P/S resistance package IS the durability; raw HP sits below band, and 1.25x double-dipped (live: 418 HP behind full physical resistance at CR 20)

lint_rules._comment: Post-generation validation. Reject or auto-correct, then regenerate flavor only.
checks: hp within archetype-adjusted [0.75, 1.35] of chassis * hp_mult
attack bonus within +/-1 of chassis + attack_mod
save DC within +/-1 of chassis + dc_mod
hp average matches dice formula: floor(NdD avg) + mod
ability mods = floor((score-10)/2); saves = mod or mod+PB
initiative bonus present with passive score in parentheses
2024 phrasing: 'Melee Attack Roll:' / 'X Saving Throw: DC n' / capitalized conditions / no 'Melee Weapon Attack'
